notes: Built from ep002.ts lines: only tags and CAPITALS added; words identical to `say`.
persona: You are an energetic, charismatic science YouTuber narrating a vertical short video. Sound like a real human influencer talking to a friend: conversational, expressive, with natural breaths and a smile in the voice. Change your speed, pitch, emphasis and rhythm with what is happening: an excited hook, tension that builds as the numbers climb (a little faster and higher each time), a punchy pause right before every big reveal, quiet awe at the climax, a playful twist, and a warm, friendly call to action. Words in CAPITALS get extra emphasis. Each line starts with a direction in parentheses: follow it, but never read the directions or the bracketed tags aloud.

lines.style: excited and fast, big smile, punch BIGGER, rising on the question
lines.tagged: What if every domino was one and a half times BIGGER than the one before?

lines.style: relaxed and conversational, a little smaller voice for something tiny
lines.tagged: The first one is about EIGHT millimeters tall.

lines.style: curious, setting up the rule, slight lean-in
lines.tagged: And each one can knock over the next.
Domino ten. Taller than a sheet of PAPER.

lines.style: quick and bright, a little higher than before
lines.tagged: Eighteen. As tall as a HOUSE.
Twenty eight. Taller than the EIFFEL TOWER.
Thirty. Taller than ANY skyscraper on Earth.
Thirty six. Taller than Mount EVEREST.

lines.style: highest energy so far, almost breathless
lines.tagged: Forty five. Higher than the SPACE STATION flies.

lines.style: dramatic: slow down, a punchy pause before the reveal, awed
lines.tagged: And domino sixty two <short pause> is TALLER than the distance to the MOON.

lines.style: quiet and playful, almost a whisper, like a secret
lines.tagged: Now give the first one a TINY push.

lines.style: a crisp click, then building awe and speed as they fall
lines.tagged: Click. <short pause> And they all come down, one after another, BIGGER and BIGGER.

lines.style: playful and conspiratorial, like sharing a secret
lines.tagged: Here's the twist. This is REAL physics.

lines.style: clear and confident, explaining something cool
lines.tagged: A falling domino can knock over one about one and a half times its size. A physics lab in Toronto does it with THIRTEEN.

lines.style: honest and warm, a small smile on the last sentence
lines.tagged: No domino could ever stand that tall. But the chain reaction is REAL.

lines.style: warm and friendly, straight to the viewer, smiling
lines.tagged: What should we knock over next? Comment below!
